description: This Java class 'ReportService' provides methods for streaming CSV reports related to project overview and fund utilization from a database. It interfaces with a repository to fetch data and formats it as CSV in a streaming response.

classes.name: ReportService
classes.description: A Spring service component that generates CSV reports for project overview and fund utilization, using streaming response to efficiently handle large datasets.

methods.name: streamProjectOverviewCsv
methods.description: Streams a CSV report of project overview with optional filters for district and status.

methods.name: streamFundUtilizationCsv
methods.description: Streams a CSV report of fund utilization, filtered by project code.

methods.name: toCsvStreamingResponse
methods.description: Converts a list of maps into a CSV formatted streaming HTTP response.

methods.name: writeCsvRow
methods.description: Writes a row of CSV data, escaping as necessary.

methods.name: formatValue
methods.description: Formats a value into a string suitable for CSV output, with special handling for dates and temporal types.

methods.name: escapeCsv
methods.description: Escapes CSV special characters by quoting and doubling quotes within fields.
